description: Trigger this skill to ingest, sanitize, and analyze technical sources (Upstream APIs and Databases). Use when you have: 1. Legacy API docs (.docx) that need conversion to OpenAPI 3.0. 2. Database table exports (.csv) that need mapping. 3. Existing mobile API contracts that need review. DO NOT use for: Designing new mobile contracts or analyzing UI screens. REQUIRES: .docx or .csv files in the /discovery folder.

tools.name: doc_converter
tools.description: Python script to convert .docx files into clean Markdown for high-fidelity API extraction.

tools.name: db_indexer
tools.description: Python script to automatically index CSV files and generate a database schema map.

runtime_directives.output_convention: OpenAPI files must use kebab-case (e.g., account-service-v1.yaml). All YAML must be valid OAS 3.0.
